comment: sc-11c seeded bugs, all Lean (no Python or Rust product code changed). Each planted alone in lean/VE/Readings/SoftSupRun.lean as committed, then `lake build VE.Readings.SoftSupRun` and `lake env lean VE/Readings/SoftSupRunExamples.lean` run and the failing #guards recorded (line numbers of SoftSupRunExamples.lean at the commit that adds this file); the file restored and rebuilt after each run.
